title: 第9章 第二株忘川花第10章 解毒前的准备
content_zh:
有时，方多病会怀疑笛飞声是挑好了时间出现的，所有的脏活累活，需要花钱的地方，方多病都解决了，笛飞声不早不晚的出现了。
其实，笛盟主这次确实是被冤枉了，他这么久不现身，是因为有了忘川花的下落，他亲自去取了。来的晚了，是因为一身的伤，他不愿意吓到方多病，也不愿意李莲花承他这份情……
“笛盟主，好久不见啊！”方多病快把自己气笑了。
笛飞声也不说话，直接又丢给方多病一个盒子。
“这回别给他，药魔明后两天就到。”
说着直接进屋，也不管李莲花诧异的眼神，倒在方多病给他准备好的床上沉沉睡去，他这是累的了，这忘川花当真是不易得！
大家都知道这忘川花是稀世珍宝，可不知这忘川花的生长环境也有诸多要求，一阴一阳一株同生的两朵花，阴花生长在阳面，阳花生长在阴面，雪山上阴阳时刻变化，笛飞声追着这变幻硬是好运气的又寻到这一株忘川花。
忘川花，方多病不用打开盒子也知道这是什么，“好阿飞，这次原谅你了，等本少爷今天亲自下厨，给你做顿好吃的。”
李莲花看笛飞声连招呼也不打一声，径直走到屋里睡觉去了，他想这人一定是方多病之前提到的笛飞声，竟是这般无礼之人嘛？自己以前交的到底都是什么朋友啊？
他也不吵笛飞声休息，出来看见方多病捧着个盒子站在院子里。
“这是什么东西？”他问方多病。
“这东西能让你夜里再不会觉得冷了，”方多病很开心，说着往房间走去，他要先将这盒子藏起来，“现在只等药魔来。”
药魔？又是什么人？竟是些奇奇怪怪的人，李莲花感慨自己以前肯定也是有些名头的，要不然怎么会认识这些形形色色的人。
笛飞声一觉醒来，已经快要日落西山了。
方多病在小院子里摆了一桌酒菜，这回是要好好犒劳一下笛大盟主，看他这睡觉的架势就知道，他这一路上没少遭罪。
“快来，快来！”方多病看见笛飞声从屋子里出来，热情的拉笛飞声坐在主位上。
一旁的李莲花早已坐好，只等着开饭。
笛飞声也不谦让，阔马金刀的坐在主位上。等笛飞声和方多病坐好，正式开饭。
“李相夷，你右手怎么了？”笛飞声看见李莲花用左手持筷子，顿时有些心焦，要是他右手出了问题，岂不是再不能痛痛快快的大战一场，李相夷可是笛飞声一生的追求啊!武道巅峰！
“啊！”李莲花觉得这人像是在问自己，可方多病一直叫自己李莲花，难道自己还有另外一个名字？这些天，他曾经旁敲侧击的询问过往事，可方多病总是含含糊糊，总不肯据实以告。

李莲花转头看着方多病，希望他可以给自己介绍一下眼前的陌生人，要是再愿意告诉自己李相夷的事情就更好了。
“李相夷是你以前的名字。”方多病总是这么善解人意，“你们两个是同一个人，没有区别。”
“阿飞，李莲花现在记性不太好了，咱们先吃饭，一会儿我解释给你听。”方多病赶紧劝阻笛飞声，不让他再问下去，忽然就明白了，在女宅时，李莲花为什么不让自己告诉阿飞，他就是笛飞声，是金鸳盟的大魔头。
原来失忆亦可以是一种幸福，不用面对以前的自己，可以暂时忘记那些烦恼。
还是让现在的李莲花能快活一天是一天吧！等到碧茶毒解了那些不高兴的回忆就会回来了。
笛飞声听了方多病的话，没有再多说什么，只是他在吃饭前挑了盘子里最大的那个鸡腿，丢给了旁边的狐狸精。狐狸精看着从天而降的鸡腿，十分高兴，尾巴都要翘到天上去了。
李莲花又止不住的在心里想，这两个人怪不得能成为朋友，都是这样的——浪费。
吃完晚饭，方多病难得的让李莲花去洗碗，他有意支开李莲花，他要和笛飞声说一下李莲花的现状和他自己的一些想法。
难得的是笛飞声也没有反对方多病的想法，反而很赞成，不知道是不是因为自己也失忆过，所以能真正的感同身受。
于是，三个人就这样一起住在海边的小院子里，等着无颜带药魔来，不一样的地方是，这次失忆的是李莲花。
从此以后，每天清早，笛飞声都会以检查方多病功课的借口，和方多病在院子里比划比划，明显这次小院不够大，不像之前的莲花楼，停在荒郊野外，渺无人烟的地方，这小院根本不够二人施展拳脚。
李莲花虽然失忆了，也还是和以前一样发了火，实在是太鸡飞狗跳了，最直接的办法就是把他俩赶出院子，让他们离远一点，免得将方多病好不容易修好的小院又拆了……
李莲花心想，这个笛飞声真是麻烦，怎么这么爱和别人打架，真是一点儿也不消停。
“李莲花，你别做饭了，等一会儿我们回来，我做。”方多病每天都是这样，一边和笛飞声打的不亦乐乎，一边大声对着李莲花喊到。
李莲花听他这样说，好像自己唯一的爱好被剥夺了一般，不做就不做，他去和狐狸精玩，有的时候，狗比人可爱多了。
看着这两个人逐渐远去的背影，李莲花也在琢磨，这两个朋友都是身手不凡的武林中人，难道自己也是一个武林高手不成，可是活动了活动手脚，还是一样的使不上力气，只是好像有什么武功招式浮现在眼前。
下意识的去摸丹田，那里有一点儿热意缓缓流动，不由的在心中自嘲一笑，身体现在差到这种地步，四肢无力还目盲，怎么还会幻想着绝世武功。
这个叫阿飞的人确实武功不凡，看着为人极为冷淡，这样的人纡尊降贵的到这小渔村来，只为了给自己解毒，看样子以前他们一定是极好的朋友，要是有幸能恢复，以后必将尽力报答。
‘汪，汪汪！’
听见旁边大黄狗的叫声，这声音里充满了不满，赶紧笑着弯腰捡起脚边的木棍，左手用力丢出去，

几乎是立刻，狐狸精奔跑的声音在耳边响起。
李莲花不由的喃喃自语，“狐狸精，狐狸精，这狗还真是聪明。”
content_en:
Sometimes, Fang Duobing would suspect that Di Feisheng appeared at a chosen time. Fang Duobing had solved all the dirty work and money needed, and Di Feisheng appeared neither early nor late.
In fact, Leader Di was indeed wronged this time. The reason he didn't show up for so long was because he knew the whereabouts of the Forgotten Flower and went to get it himself. He came late because he was injured. He didn't want to scare Fang Duobing, and he didn't want Li Lianhua to accept his love...
"Leader Di, long time no see!" Fang Duobing almost laughed out loud.
Di Feisheng didn't say anything and threw another box to Fang Duobing.
"Don't give it to him this time. The demon will arrive in two days."
After saying that, he went straight into the room, ignoring Li Lianhua's surprised eyes, and fell into a deep sleep on the bed prepared for him by Fang Duobing. He was tired. This Wangchuan flower was really hard to come by!
Everyone knows that the Forgotten Flower is a rare treasure, but they don’t know that the growing environment of the Forgotten Flower also has many requirements. There are two flowers, one yin and one yang, growing at the same time. The yin flower grows on the sunny side and the yang flower grows on the shady side. The yin and yang on the snow-capped mountains change all the time. Di Feisheng chased this change and was lucky enough to find this Forgotten Flower again.
Forget the Flower of Sichuan, Fang Duobing knew what it was without opening the box, "Good Fei, I forgive you this time. I will cook for you today and make you a delicious meal."
When Li Lianhua saw Di Feisheng, he didn't even say hello and went straight to the house to sleep. He thought that this person must be the Di Feisheng mentioned by Fang Duobing before. How could he be such a rude person? What kind of friends did you have in the past?
He stopped playing the flute and took a rest. When he came out, he saw Fang Duobing standing in the yard holding a box.
"What is this?" he asked Fang Duobing.
"This thing will make you no longer feel cold at night," Fang Duobing was very happy and walked towards the room. He wanted to hide the box first, "Now we just wait for the medicine demon to come."
Drug demon? Who is it again? They turned out to be some strange people. Li Lianhua lamented that she must have had some reputation before, otherwise how could she know these all kinds of people.
When Di Feisheng woke up, it was almost sunset.
Fang Duobing set up a table of wine and food in the small courtyard. This time he wanted to reward the leader of the Di Alliance. Looking at the way he slept, it was clear that he had suffered a lot along the way.
"Come on, come on!" Fang Duobing saw Di Feisheng coming out of the house, playing the flute enthusiastically and sitting on the main seat.
Li Lianhua on the side had already sat down, just waiting for the meal to begin.
Di Feisheng was also unimpressed, sitting on the main seat with a broad horse and a golden sword. After Di Feisheng and Fang Duobing were seated, dinner officially began.
"Li Xiangyi, what's wrong with your right hand?" Di Feisheng saw Li Lianhua holding chopsticks with his left hand, and suddenly became a little anxious. If there was something wrong with his right hand, wouldn't it mean that he would no longer be able to fight happily? Li Xiangyi is Di Feisheng's lifelong pursuit! The pinnacle of martial arts!
"Ah!" Li Lianhua felt like this man was asking himself, but Fang Duobing kept calling him Li Lianhua, does he have another name? These days, he had asked about past events in a circumstantial way, but Fang Duobing was always vague and refused to tell the truth.
Li Lianhua turned to look at Fang Duobing, hoping that he could introduce the stranger in front of her to her. It would be better if he was willing to tell her about Li Xiangyi.
"Li Xiangyi was your previous name." Fang Duobing was always so considerate, "You two are the same person, there is no difference."
"A Fei, Li Lianhua's memory is not very good right now. Let's eat first and I'll explain it to you later." Fang Duobing quickly dissuaded Di Feisheng from asking any more questions. Suddenly he understood why Li Lianhua didn't let himself tell A Fei when they were in the women's house. He was Di Feisheng, the big devil of the Golden Yuan Alliance.
It turns out that amnesia can also be a kind of happiness. You don't have to face your former self and you can temporarily forget those troubles.
Let the current LiThe lotus flower can be happy every day! Those unhappy memories will come back after the Bitcha poison is detoxified.
Di Feisheng listened to Fang Duobing's words and didn't say anything more. He just picked the largest chicken leg on the plate and threw it to the vixen next to him before eating. The vixen was so happy when she saw the chicken legs falling from the sky that her tail almost reached the sky.
Li Lianhua couldn't help but think to herself, no wonder these two people could become friends, they were both such a waste.
After dinner, Fang Duobing rarely asked Li Lianhua to wash the dishes. He deliberately dismissed Li Lianhua. He wanted to tell Di Feisheng about Li Lianhua's current situation and some of his own thoughts.
What's rare is that Di Feisheng didn't object to Fang Duobing's idea. Instead, he agreed with it. I wonder if it was because he had also experienced amnesia, so he could truly empathize with it.
So, the three of them lived together in a small courtyard by the sea, waiting for Wuyan to bring the medicine demon. The difference was that this time it was Li Lianhua who lost his memory.
From then on, every morning, Di Feisheng would use the excuse of checking Fang Duobing's homework to sign with Fang Duobing in the courtyard. Obviously, the small courtyard this time was not big enough. Unlike the previous Lotus Building, which was parked in the wilderness and in an uninhabited place, this small courtyard was not big enough for the two of them to use their skills.
Although Li Lianhua lost her memory, she was still as angry as before. She was so upset that the most direct way was to drive the two of them out of the yard and keep them away, so as not to demolish the small yard that Fang Duobing had finally repaired...
Li Lianhua thought to herself, this Di Feisheng is really troublesome. Why does he like to fight with others so much? He really won't stop at all.
"Li Lianhua, please stop cooking. We will come back later and I will cook." Fang Duobing was like this every day, shouting to Li Lianhua loudly while having a great fight with Di Fei.
When Li Lianhua heard what he said, it was as if her only hobby had been deprived of her. If she didn't want to do it, she wouldn't do it. He went to play with the vixen. Sometimes, dogs are much cuter than people.
Looking at the backs of these two people gradually walking away, Li Lianhua was also wondering, these two friends were both martial arts practitioners with extraordinary skills. Could it be that he was also a martial arts master? However, even if he moved his hands and feet, he still had no strength, but some martial arts moves seemed to appear in front of his eyes.
Subconsciously, I touched my Dantian, and there was a little warmth flowing slowly there. I couldn't help but laugh at myself. My body was in such a bad condition, my limbs were weak and I was blind. How could I still fantasize about peerless martial arts?
This man named Ah Fei indeed has extraordinary martial arts skills, but he seems to be extremely cold-blooded. Such a man has come to this small fishing village with dignity, just to detoxify himself. It seems that they must have been very good friends in the past. If they are lucky enough to recover, they will try their best to repay the favor in the future.
‘Woof, woof woof! ’
Hearing the barking of the big yellow dog next to him, the voice was full of dissatisfaction. He quickly smiled and bent down to pick up the wooden stick at his feet, and threw it out with his left hand.
Almost immediately, the sound of the vixen running sounded in his ears.
Li Lianhua couldn't help but murmured to herself, "Vixy, vixen, this dog is really smart."
